title: Yume Kira Dream Shoppe
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rin, an androgynous shopkeeper of a magic shop that flies through the dusk sky, grants wishes in exchange for something dear to the wisher. Four standalone stories follow a tree spirit who wants to thank an ailing composer, a stuffed rabbit who wants to help his shy owner, an amnesiac seeking her past, and a shy girl hoping to get closer to a classmate.
life_message: Sincere feelings and the courage to act on them matter more than magic, and every wish has a cost.
